{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Drop refunded orders — they don't contribute to real revenue
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Now, restrict to converted orders only: converted == 1
# Because the estimand is 'revenue per converted order'
df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Check: now only converted, completed, non-QA orders
print(f'Final number of rows: {len(df)}')

# Check distribution of channels and segments
df[['channel', 'customer_segment']].value_counts().sort_index()"}
